ud4.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Cālikāyaṃ viharati, Cālike pabbate.
ud4.1:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Meghiyo bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud4.1:1.4: atha kho āyasmā Meghiyo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi, ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho āyasmā Meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:1.5: icchām' ahaṃ bhante Jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisitun ti.
ud4.1:1.6: yassa dāni tvaṃ Meghiya kālaṃ maññasī 'ti.
ud4.1:2.1: atha kho āyasmā Meghiyo pubbaṇhasamayan nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi,
ud4.1:2.2: Jantugāme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Kimikālāya nadiyā tīraṃ, ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Kimikālāya nadiyā tīre jaṅghavihāraṃ anucaṅkamāno anuvicaramāno
ud4.1:2.5: pāsādikaṃ vat' idaṃ ambavanaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ. alaṃ vat' idaṃ kulaputtassa padhānatthikassa padhānāya.
ud4.1:2.6: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyy' āhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā 'ti.
ud4.1:3.1: atha kho āyasmā Meghiyo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
ud4.1:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:4.1: idh' āhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ,
ud4.1:4.2: Jantugāme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Kimikālāya nadiyā tīraṃ, ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Kimikālāya nadiyā tīre jaṅghavihāraṃ anucaṅkamāno anuvicaramāno
ud4.1:4.6: alaṃ vat' idaṃ kulaputtassa padhānatthikassa padhānāya.
ud4.1:4.7: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyy' āhaṃ idaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā 'ti.
ud4.1:4.8: sace maṃ bhante bhagavā anujānāti, gaccheyy' āhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā 'ti.
ud4.1:5.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Meghiyaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:5.2: āgamehi tāva Meghiya, ekak' amhā tāva, yāva añño pi koci bhikkhu āgacchatī 'ti.
ud4.1:6.1: dutiyam pi kho āyasma Meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:6.2: bhagavato bhante n' atthi kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ n' atthi katassa vā paticayo,
ud4.1:6.3: mayhaṃ kho pana bhante atthi uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ, atthi katassa paticayo.
ud4.1:6.4: sace maṃ bhante bhagavā anujānāti, gaccheyy' āhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā 'ti.
ud4.1:6.5: dutiyam pi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Meghiyaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:7.1: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:7.5: padhānan ti kho Meghiya vadamānaṃ kinti vadeyyāma.
ud4.1:7.6: yassa dāni tvaṃ Meghiya kālaṃ maññasī 'ti.
ud4.1:8.1: atha kho āyasmā Meghiyo uṭṭhāy' āsamā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena taṃ ambavanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ ambavanaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
ud4.1:8.2: atha kho āyasmato Meghiyassa tasmiṃ ambavane viharantassa yebhuyyena tayo pāpakā akusalā vitakkā samudācaranti, seyyath' īdaṃ:
ud4.1:9.1: atha kho āyasmato Meghiyassa etad ahosi:
ud4.1:9.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
ud4.1:9.3: saddhāya ca vat' amhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito,
ud4.1:9.4: atha ca pan' imehi tīhi pāpakehi akusalehi vitakkehi anvāsanno, seyyath' īdaṃ:
ud4.1:10.1: atha kho āyasmā Meghiyo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.1:10.2: idha mayhaṃ bhante tasmiṃ ambavane viharantassa yebhuyyena tāyo papakā akusalā vitakkā samudācaranti . . . pe . . .
ud4.1:11.1: aparipakkāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā pañca dhammā paripākāya saṃvattanti.
ud4.1:12.1: idha Meghiya bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasaṃpavaṅko.
ud4.1:12.2: aparipākāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ paṭhamo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati..
ud4.1:13.1: puna ca paraṃ Meghiya bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
ud4.1:13.2: aparipākāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ dutiyo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati..
ud4.1:14.1: puna ca paraṃ Meghiya bhikkhu yā 'yaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati, seyyath' īdaṃ: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
ud4.1:14.2: aparipākāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ tatiyo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati. 4.
ud4.1:15.1: puna ca paraṃ Meghiya bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
ud4.1:15.2: aparipākāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ catuttho dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati..
ud4.1:16.1: puna ca paraṃ Meghiya bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
ud4.1:16.2: aparipākāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ pañcamo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati.
ud4.1:16.3: aparipākāya Meghiya cetovimuttiyā ime pañca dhammā paripākāya saṃvattanti.
ud4.1:17.1: kalyāṇamittass' etaṃ Meghiya bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa, yaṃ sīlavā bhavissati, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissati, ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
ud4.1:18.1: kalyāṇamittass' etaṃ . . . kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa, yaṃ sīlavā bhavissati pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto (?), yā 'yaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattissati, seyyath' īdaṃ: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññakathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā evarūpāya kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
ud4.1:19.1: kalyānamittass' . . . kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa, yaṃ āraddhaviriyo bhavissati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
ud4.1:20.1: kalyāṇamittass' . . . sampavaṅkassa, yaṃ paññavā bhavissati udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
ud4.1:21.1: tena ca pana Meghiya bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro dhammā uttari bhāvetabbā,
ud4.1:21.2: asubhā bhāvetabbā rāgassa pahānāya, mettā bhāvetabbā byāpādassa pahānāya, ānāpānasati bhāvetabbā vitakkupacchedāya, aniccasaññā bhāvetabbā asmimānasamugghātāya.
ud4.1:21.4: anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpunāti diṭṭhe 'va dhamme nibbānan ti.
ud4.1:22.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
